r_template:
local({
  df <- .active_data
  v <- df[[ '{{var}}' ]]
  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df, ggplot2::aes(x = {{escapeR var}})) +
    ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = {{bins}}, fill = '#4f46e5', color = '#ffffff', alpha = 0.85) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste('Distribution of', '{{var}}'),
      x = '{{var}}',
      y = 'Count'
    )
  rrad_emit_plot(p, title = paste('Histogram:', '{{var}}'))
})
